title: radbondi: Time-dependent spherical Bondi accretion solver with radiative cooling
description: Time-dependent spherical Bondi accretion solver with pluggable radiative cooling. Solves the 1D spherical Euler equations with an implicit cooling source term and converges to a self-consistent steady state, in regimes where the standard ODE shooting method fails (the sonic point becomes a focus rather than a saddle). Developed for the study of primordial black holes accreting in stellar interiors (Cantiello, Gottlieb, Norton, Kleban & Van Tilburg, ApJ, submitted).
